title: Back into the account
transcript:
Customer: I cannot sign into my account.
Agent: I can help. Have you tried the password reset link?
Customer: Yes, the email just arrived.
Agent: Open it and choose a new password. Do not share the password with me.
Customer: Done. I can sign in now.

key_points: Customer confirmed successful sign-in after resetting the password.
expected.resolution_details: Customer confirmed successful sign-in after resetting the password.
